purpose: DatePicker picks **one date**, optionally with a time, in a form field. A trigger button opens a popover that holds a month grid, a typed date field (and a time field with `showTime`), an optional footer and a Cancel / Apply pair. The selection is staged in a draft inside the popover and committed to `v-model` only on Apply (or immediately when `show-apply` is false); Cancel closes the popover, discards the draft and returns focus to the trigger. The pair matches `date-range-picker`'s footer: a ghost Cancel and a primary Apply, so both pickers commit the same way. Date math uses the native `Date` API only — no date library; the trigger formats the value with `Intl` in `v-model:time-zone` (the local zone when empty). Before 6.0 this component was `Calendar` and also picked ranges, periods and presets; every range — relative or absolute, with or without times — now belongs to `date-range-picker`, which reuses this component's month grid and fields as internal parts. The name follows Cloudscape DatePicker and the shadcn "Date Picker".
useWhen: Use DatePicker to pick one date (optionally with a time) in a form field. For any start–end range use DateRangePicker; to display a moment in time use Timestamp.
A due date, a start date, an expiry date, a birthday.
A date and a time of day together (`show-time`): a scheduled maintenance window start, a release time.
avoidWhen: A start and an end, whole days or with times, relative or absolute → use `date-range-picker`.
Displaying a date the person does not edit → use `timestamp`.
A duration or count (retention days, TTL) rather than a date → use `number-input`.
related: `date-range-picker` — every range: relative windows (`last 15 minutes`) kept relative, absolute ranges down to the minute, and whole days with `:show-time="false"`. It is built on this component's grid, fields and time zone selector.
`timestamp` — shows a moment in time in the app's time zone.
`field` — inside a `Field`, the trigger takes the field's label (`for` points at it), description, `invalid` and `disabled`.
`select` — the Month and Year selects in the calendar caption (`variant="ghost"`, `size="small"`).
`combobox` — the time field: a typed time or a pick from the 30-minute list, which opens under the field so the panel stays as thin as the grid.
`input` — the trigger and the date field share its heights, hover, and disabled treatment, so they align side by side.
bestPractices: `modelValue` is committed only on Apply; read the final value from `update:modelValue` or the second argument of `apply`, and set `:show-apply="false"` when every edit should commit at once.

Bound the selectable days with `min` and `max` instead of validating after commit. Unlike `date-range-picker` (five years back to the end of today by default), DatePicker is unbounded by default: a single date is often in the future (a token expiry, an alert schedule), so a page sets `min` to today there, and sets `max` only when the date must be in the past.
Send `toISOString()` (or the ISO date `2026-11-15`) to the server, never the printed label.
